page_title: 2Do Mac - Powerful Tasks, Lists, and Project Planning

summary.name: 2Do
summary.one_liner: 2Do is a task manager for Mac (also on iOS and iPad) offering lists, projects, tags, smart lists, and sync with services like Dropbox, Apple Reminders, Todoist, iCloud, and CalDAV.
use_cases: planning a trip or project with checklists
capturing ideas quickly from anywhere on a Mac
syncing tasks across Apple devices and other services
summary.what_it_does: 2Do is a task and project manager for the Mac with lists, sub-tasks, checklists, sections, and tags. Tasks take natural language input for dates, times, durations, priority, and tags. Quick Entry captures tasks from anywhere on the Mac, and mail sent to a private 2Do address becomes a task. Smart Lists save custom searches, and Focus filters narrow a list to chosen conditions. Sync is offered through Dropbox, Apple Reminders, Todoist, iCloud, Fastmail, Fruux, or any CalDAV server, and lists can be shared over iCloud or local Wi-Fi.
notable: Natural language input such as 'tomorrow at 3pm [30m] #carpool' sets date, duration and tag in one line
Mail-to-task private email address with subject instructions like due(tomorrow)
Multiple sync options including Dropbox, Apple Reminders, Todoist, and CalDAV, with no requirement to store data with the vendor
Built-in MCP server so Claude or other MCP agents can work with live tasks
caveats: Sharing lists through iCloud requires iCloud sharing support on macOS 14, iOS 18, or iPadOS 18 or later
Some features such as Apple Intelligence section grouping depend on Apple's own services
Pricing is not stated on the page
